body: I have been the beginning of ideas for all time, yet I am just one simple small object, the things that you can use me for can be frustrating and also I can be pretty. I have some of the most valuable thing in the world on me, yet almost everyone owns me. With me you can make anything. What am I?
I have branches but no fruit, trunk, or leaves. What am I?
I have cities but no houses. I have forests but no trees. I have water but no fish. What am I?
I have cities with no people, forests with no trees and oceans with no water. What am I?
I have Eighty-eight keys but cannot open a single door. What am I?
I have every color but no gold. What am I?
I have fangs and enjoy piecing holes with a single bit. What am I?
I have feathers that help me fly; with head and body but I'm not alive. Very skinny and a fixed length, how far I go depends on?
I have feet on my head. What am I?
I have five letters and people eat me. When you remove my first letter I become a crime. Remove my first two letters and I am an animal. If you remove my first and last letters I'm a form of music?
I have four eyes, yet I can’t see a thing. What am I?
I have four legs but no tail. Usually I am heard only at night?
I have four legs, one head and a foot. What am I?
I have four wings but cannot fly. I never laugh and never cry. On the same spot always found, toiling away with little sound?
I have got three eyes and all are in a straight line. When my red eyes opens, everything freezes. What am I?
I have green hair, a round red head and a long thin white beard. What am I?
I have hands but cannot clap. What am I?
I have holes on the top and bottom. I have holes on my left and on my right. And I have holes in the middle, Yet I still hold water?
I have horns but I can’t beep. I like to bleat but I’m not a sheep. What am I?
I have keys but cannot open any locks. Sometimes loud, sometimes soft. What am I?
I have keys but no doors. I have space but no rooms, I allow you to enter but you are never able to leave. What am I?
I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter but can't go outside?
I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter but can't go outside. What am I?
I have keys but no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter but cannot go outside. What am I?
I have lakes with no water, mountains with no stone and cities with no buildings. What am I?
I have leaves on my fruit, my fruit is on my leaves. What am I?
I have legs but never walk, I may have flowers but no soil, I hold food but never eat?
I have legs but seldom walk; I backbite many but never talk; I seek places that can hide me because those that feed me cannot abide me?
I have legs but walk not, a strong back but work not, two good arms but reach not, a seat but sits and tarry not?
I have legs but walk not, a strong back but work not. Two good arms but reach not. A seat but sit and tarry not?
I have long legs, crooked thighs, little head and no eyes. What am I?
I have many feathers to help me fly. I have a body and head but I'm not alive. It is your strength which determines how far I go. You can hold me in your hand but I'm never thrown?
I have many feathers to help me fly. I have a body and head but I'm not alive. Your strength determines how far I go. You can hold me in your hand but I'm never thrown?
I have many keys but cannot open any doors. What am I?
I have many letters and though it's strange to say, I stay the same no matter How many I give away?
I have married many woman but has never been married. What am I?
I have married many women but I am not married. Who am I?
I have memories but none of my own, whatever's on my inside is what is shown. If I'm ever different it's because you changed me, I feel like a decoration, here for you to arrange me. What am I?
I have more shoes than anybody but less feet than everyone. I am met in the morning but departed in the night. I may shake as if I'm angry but I won't bite. What am I?
I have no beginning, end, or middle. What am I?
I have no bones and no legs but if you keep me warm, I will soon walk away. What am I?
I have no end and am the ending of all that begins. What am I?
I have no eyes, no legs or ears and I help move the earth. What am I?

I have no head and a tail I lack but I do have arms and legs and back; I inhabit the palace, the tavern, the cot, 'tis a beggarly residence where I am not. If a monarch were present (I tell you no fable), I still should be placed at the head of the table. What am I?

I have no head and a tail I lack but oft have arms and legs and back; I inhabit the palace, the tavern, the cot, 'Tis a beggarly residence where I am not. If a monarch were present (I tell you no fable), I still should be placed at the head of the table?
I have no legs. I will never walk but always run. What am I?
I have no life but I can die. What am I?
I have no voice but I can teach you all there is to know. I have spines and hinges but I am not a door. Once I've told you all, I cannot tell you more. What am I?
I have no wings but I can fly. And I have no eyes but I can cry. What am I?
I have one eye. See near and far. I hold the moments you treasure and the things that make you weep?
